what: OS file window — when it becomes visible it pops out from .8x and transparent over .12s power4.out, dragging the title bar moves it, and the pressed window comes to the front. The lens plate inside the window body is always aligned to the top left of the plate the window sits on (with a random ±10px offset), so when you drag the window the big picture inside stays stuck in place while only the window passes over it — placing an enlarged plate of the same picture on the lens plate makes each window magnify a different part of the picture.

options.shift: Random offset width of lens plates (px), default 20 (±10)
options.pop: If false, it does not pop out and is visible from the start
options.delay: Delay before popping out (seconds), default 0 — stagger several windows (.15 apart)
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Drag handle title bar (whole window if none)
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Body that holds the lens panel (overflow hidden)
options.[data-fx-part=lens]: An image panel as large as the panel the window sits on — it is attached to that panel’s top left

note: No dragging on devices without hand response (touch) — as in the original, the window can’t be dragged on phones and the page scrolls down
